action.objective: Recapture the knight with Qxe5, eliminating Black's strong central knight and keeping the queen active on e5.
action.rationale: Qxe5 is the sole commit_ready move: broad depth-3 search ranked it first (exact 606), single-candidate verification at effective depth 4 confirmed exact 606 with safety.complete true and tactical_refutation not_found. It wins material (f3e5 was traded off, and Black's Ne5 is now captured). Black's practical replies Bxb3 or Qxa4/Qxb3 do not refute this; the queen is well-placed centrally attacking c5/c7. No forced mate against us. Committing the verified move.
